title: Tycen Anderson gives the Broncos another special teams ace

sources.title: Tycen Anderson gives the Broncos another special teams ace
sources.description: With their 166th overall selection in the 5th round of the 2022 NFL Draft, the Cincinnati Bengals selected safety Tycen Anderson. After a successful college career at Toledo, Anderson looked to make a name for himself in the NFL with the Bengals. His rookie season with the Bengals was cut short due to a hamstring […]
